venues.name: CC Nashville

Comps $69 / 10% (high for a slow night; MOD MD gifted a handful of Greedo shots to Star Wars-fan guests visiting from Pelatos). Korey + John Michael did some old-product clearing in the kitchen; positive guest feedback on the new food items (dogs called out as a favorite). MOD/Chef: MD. No 86s, no maintenance flags. Entered by BT. **Context**: weekend graduation festivities (per Kala in #ccnsh_eon_report thread) pulled crowds Saturday but emptied Sunday before church. Continues the structural weakness pattern — sub-$130 food day now hit on 13 of last 15 reported days.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: Solid Mother's Day Sunday — +12.3% vs target ($4,266 vs $3,800). Food $385, Bev $3,841, Retail $40. 115 guests (SevenRooms) / $37 GCA. Comps $85.91. Bumpy night with deep fallows (room went from 80% to 15% in twenty minutes around 7:30 due to dinner reservation tail), but room got nearly full again by 10:30pm with a vivid late mix: a Columbus bar director seeking program-development counsel, German 'fuzzy mouthfeel' fruity drinkers, and bachelor partiers from the PNW. 3 large parties, 6 solos, 3 investor cocktails. Top sellers: First Time Listener, Material Control, Buckhorn Exchange. **Door notes (Thomas)**: Mother's Day eclipsed by early brunches — chill start, decent 6pm reservation push, low foot traffic until late; 10:30pm wave brought near-capacity. Welcomed Nick Stropko (Eavesdrop owner/GM) and Robert Burns (Len Len bar mgr); David Cross (comedian/actor) joined a friend's birthday. Celebrity serve: Tobias Fünke (per MOD) ordered 'an effete and sagacious drink. Tequila' and stayed for seconds. **No-shows**: Wade Laycook (2 at 8:30pm) — charged. **Maintenance/repairs**: investor portal apparently malfunctioning on reservation acceptance — worth investigating (red investor had text confirmation but reservation didn't show on EV side). MOD/Chef: Seth & Alejandro. Entered by Thomas. **Backfill note**: EV 5/9 report (which was outstanding at last run) was submitted by Sean Pop on 2026-05-10 13:55 EDT — backfilled in this run.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Mix of sun and showers on and off all day
venues.narrative: Mother's Day on-target — +2.4% vs target ($12,285 vs $12,000) — second effective on-target day in a row after a long stretch of misses. Segments: MB Morning $6,533 (105 guests), MB Evening reported $0 (likely form data-entry error — evening notes describe full bar + steady dinner service; implied MB PM is ~$4,147 to reconcile with stated total), Sun Club $653 (Brigid had a good wave of hotel guests once weather cleared ~2pm — one rooftop oyster service), Hot Eye $952 (very quiet until ~9pm; bar crawl + service-industry pop including Jason from Common doing a send-off on his last shift). Total food $6,124 (~49.8% mix — strong food day reflecting brunch volume). 235 OpenTable covers (105 AM + 130 PM) / $52.28 GCA on stated total. Comps $270. **Brunch service**: slower-than-expected for Mother's Day with very few walk-ins; mostly reservation-based. Strongest push 1-3pm when bar top filled; James, Chandler, Aimee kept drinks moving; full ticket rail at the kitchen, nothing over 20 minutes; sold out of lobster rolls and even sold caviar on them. **Dinner**: spillover from brunch into HH; weather cleared ~2pm bringing walk-ins; started PM with ~20 covers on the books, walk-ins slowed after 6pm; bar full 5-7pm then largely died by 9; no new guests past 9:30. **Kitchen**: nothing notable from the slower dinner; 86 pomegranate for the mousse. MOD AM: Gabby/Sam & Lex; PM: Justin & Sukru. Highlights: mothers celebrating with families; Shannon (Husk) stopped in with an old friend from Athens; Victoria + partner Chris enjoyed a round downstairs. Entered by Alexis. **Data quality flag**: MB Evening Total Sales = $0 in the form is implausible given the narrative — likely typo or skip; total net sales $12,285 used as authoritative.
